name: AgentGuard Security
description: Evaluates OpenClaw tool calls and outbound messages through AgentGuard Guard API.

guardApiBaseUrl.description: Guard API URL. HTTP is allowed only for explicit loopback addresses; remote targets require HTTPS and redirects are rejected.

strongApprovalBindingEnabled.description: Enable canary strong-binding processing. Server-declared execution leases are always enforced, but current OpenClaw cannot atomically replace and seal the final action, so heartbeat C3 remains false.

runtimeBindingId.description: Trusted runtime binding identifier provisioned with this OpenClaw adapter. It must exactly match a server-declared strong binding.

adapterToken.label: AgentGuard adapter token SecretRef
adapterToken.help: Use an OpenClaw SecretRef; plaintext tokens are not accepted.

strongApprovalBindingEnabled.label: Strong approval binding canary
strongApprovalBindingEnabled.help: Enables canary processing; current OpenClaw lacks atomic replace-and-seal, so C3 is not advertised. Server-declared execution leases still fail closed.

runtimeBindingId.label: Runtime binding ID
runtimeBindingId.help: Provision this value out of band. Missing or mismatched values fail closed for server-declared bindings.
